description: An auto insurance policy declarations page: who is insured, by whom, for what period, and the schedule of coverages with their covered-auto symbols, limits and premiums

insurer.description: Name of the insurance company issuing the policy, as printed in the page heading

form_title.description: Title of the declarations form, e.g. 'Business Auto Coverage Declarations'

policy_number.description: The policy number. When no field on the page is labelled policy number, it is the prominent standalone identifier printed in the top-left block alongside the cross reference number caption; never the renewal number

renewal_number.description: The number printed above the 'RENEWAL NUMBER' caption, i.e. the policy this one renews

named_insured.description: ITEM ONE: the named insured and its mailing address

address.description: Full mailing address of the named insured, street, city, state and ZIP on one line

form_of_business.description: Form of the named insured's business, e.g. Individual, Partnership, Corporation, LLC

business_description.description: The named insured's business as described on the page, e.g. 'Trucking'

coverages.description: ITEM TWO: every row of the schedule of coverages and covered autos, in the order printed, including rows with no entry

coverage.description: Coverage name as printed in the COVERAGES column, e.g. 'LIABILITY', 'UNINSURED MOTORISTS', 'COLLISION COVERAGE'

covered_auto_symbols.description: Covered auto symbol(s) entered for this coverage, e.g. '1' or '7'; null if blank

limit.description: The limit of insurance as printed, e.g. '1,000,000 CSL' or 'See M 3912b (08/2001)'; null if blank. Omit the $ sign that is preprinted on the form

premium.description: Premium shown for this coverage as printed, e.g. '5,293' or 'INCL'; null if blank

estimated_total_premium.description: The estimated total premium for the policy, in dollars

premium_for_endorsements.description: Premium for endorsements, in dollars; null if blank

forms_and_endorsements.description: Forms and endorsements contained in the policy at inception, as printed

minimum_earned_premium.description: The fully earned policywriting minimum premium if cancelled by the insured, in dollars

schedule_of_covered_autos.description: ITEM THREE: the schedule of covered autos, or the reference printed in its place such as 'AS ATTACHED'

countersigning_agency.description: Agency named at the countersignature line, with its location

form_number.description: The declarations form number printed at the bottom left, e.g. 'M-5605 (02/2011)'

issue_date.description: Date printed at the bottom right of the page, as MM/DD/YYYY
